definitions.explanation: The money spent on staying at a hotel, inn, or other lodging facility.

examples.japanese: {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}は{一泊|いっぱく}{一万円|いちまんえん}だ。
examples.english: The accommodation cost is 10,000 yen per night.

examples.japanese: {出張|しゅっちょう}の{宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}は{会社|かいしゃ}が{負担|ふたん}する。
examples.english: The company covers the accommodation costs for business trips.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{予算|よさん}のうち、{宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}が{一番|いちばん}{大|おお}きな{割合|わりあい}を{占|し}めている。
examples.english: Among the travel budget items, accommodation costs make up the largest share.

notes:
A compound of {宿泊|しゅくはく} (staying overnight; lodging) and {費|ひ} (expense; cost). A standard term used in both personal travel and business contexts. In business settings, {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ} is typically an itemized expense on travel reimbursement forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}を{払|はら}う: to pay accommodation costs
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}を{節約|せつやく}する: to save on accommodation costs
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}{込|こ}み: accommodation included
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}の{精算|せいさん}: settlement of lodging expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}: lodging fee — nearly identical; {料|りょう} emphasizes the fee charged, while {費|ひ} emphasizes the cost incurred
- {滞在費|たいざいひ}: cost of stay — broader, covering all expenses during a stay (meals, transport, etc.)
